evidence.observation: Flow dropped abruptly from ~100 to ~55 sccm for ~20 s (k=118-121) despite 100 sccm setpoint, then recovered
Tube pressure fell in lockstep to ~2.59 Torr during the flow dip, confirming a real gas-delivery excursion, not a sensor artifact
Early growth temperature overshoot ~762 °C settling to 750 °C by ~t=2700; otherwise control nominal
Cooldown flow 200 sccm and monotonic cooling are nominal

args.missing_evidence: Post-run characterization (Raman/SEM/optical) of the film, plus MFC valve/command logs during t=3080-3100 to confirm a transient flow-controller fault versus upstream supply disturbance.
